lines.text: Nimi, my laptop is broken! I keep tapping the screen and nothing happens!
Arjun, that's a MacBook. MacBooks have never had touchscreens.
Well, until now. On October 28, Apple unveiled its first MacBook with a touchscreen.
It's a new MacBook Pro with a tandem OLED display, up to 2,000 nits at its brightest.
And the iPhone's Dynamic Island comes to the Mac for the first time.
So I can poke my laptop like my phone? How much?
It starts at $2,899. That's $400 more than the same MacBook Pro without touch.
Four hundred dollars... just to poke?
Preorders are open now, and it arrives on November 6.
Fine. I'll keep poking this one... for free.
